title: Local Asymptotic Minimax Welfare Regret under Exact Finite-Sample Harm Control
banked_reason: D0.5.G assigns subfield below the field floor (paper_score_ceiling 6.6 < 7.4), salvageable=false; technical panels pass without findings.

proof_attempt_summary: D0 proved the all-procedure local Gaussian lower transfer, an exact finite-sample-safe attaining policy, and the analytic frontier for every fixed local radius. The math and decision panels passed without findings, and both cited Hirano-Porter results were source-attested. The novelty panel rated this complete two-cell result subfield, below the fixed field floor; a broader model or empirical binding-tie application would require a separate program.
tldr: For every fixed local-cube radius \(h>0\), the unrestricted all-procedure local asymptotic minimax scaled welfare regret under exact unconditional finite-sample harm control is \(M_h=V_h\), and one explicit augmented-count policy attains it while remaining exactly safe at every sample size and every law in \(\Theta\).  The Gaussian game is solved analytically at every radius: opposite corners are least favorable for \(0<h\le h_0\), where \(h_0\approx0.291131290614\) and \(V_h=3h\Phi(-\sqrt{14/3}\,h)\); the support moves along two cube faces for \(h_0<h<h_\star\); and the value is the constant \((d_\star/2)\Phi(-z_\star)\approx0.240375586831\) for \(h\ge h_\star\approx0.398697663862\).  On strict small cubes, nuisance coordinates are decision-relevant, with contrast-only excess value \(U_h-V_h=((\sqrt{21}-9/2)/\sqrt\pi)h^2+O(h^4)\) as \(h\downarrow0\).  The attaining rule uses the explicit optimal halfspace mollification \(\bar p_{h,L}(M)=\Phi\{w_h^\top Z_L(M)/(\epsilon_L\lVert w_h\rVert_2)\}\); both greedy endpoints have identical pointwise spend, so the add-one identity gives exact safety without a first-order welfare surcharge.
gap: Jin--Egami's exact-safe learned-policy welfare theorem excludes score atoms. Hirano--Porter (2009), Theorems 3.4--3.5, already solve the unconstrained Gaussian treatment-rule reduction. Wu, Jiang, Luo, and Geng (2025), Theorems 1--3, characterize a population harm-constrained individualized treatment rule and its large-sample plug-in behavior, but do not provide exact finite-sample safety or an all-procedure constrained local-minimax value at a score atom.
fill: The novel work consists of the unrestricted constrained-LAN equivalence, certified Gaussian game, large-cube saddle, and augmented-count observed-data rule. Indexed ratio estimates produce the stated four-coordinate Gaussian statistic, a shrinking Gaussian convolution transfers every Borel selector without a boundary condition, and a slow selector diagonal approaches \(V_h\). The add-one normalization proves global exact safety for every randomized endpoint draw, while exponentially small total-count shortfall and second-order endpoint leakage prove local attainment. For each \(h\), the local comparison is uniformly stated only for \(n\ge n_0(h)\).
